## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported in the `provider` block:

- `proxy` (Block List, Optional) Proxy used by resources and data sources that connect to external endpoints.
  - `from_env` (Boolean, Optional) When `true` the provider will discover the proxy configuration from environment variables. This is based upon [`http.ProxyFromEnvironment`](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#ProxyFromEnvironment) and it supports the same environment variables (default: `true`).
  - `password` (String, Optional, Sensitive) Password used for Basic authentication against the Proxy.
  - `url` (String, Optional) URL used to connect to the Proxy. Accepted schemes are: `http`, `https`, `socks5`.
  - `username` (String, Optional) Username (or Token) used for Basic authentication against the Proxy.
